watches.name: Verdure Atelier
watches.description: Verdure Atelier Bespoke Timepieces and Fine Jewelry Your Story. Your Design. Your Heirloom. Some moments stay with us for a lifetime. A wedding, a personal achievement, a family tradition or a journey that changed everything. Verdure Atelier gives those moments a form you can hold, wear and pass down. Verdure Atelier is a private bespoke service where founder and designer Eddie Johnson works with clients to create original timepieces, fine jewelry and matching collections inspired by their personal stories. Every commission starts with a conversation. Eddie learns about the person, the occasion and the meaning behind the piece before putting pencil to paper. The first sketch becomes the starting point for a design made for one individual. More Than a Watch or a Piece of Jewelry Whether you have a watch design in mind, a family signet ring you want to create, a pendant with personal meaning or a collection that brings several pieces together, the Atelier gives you the opportunity to take part in the design process. You can explore custom dials, casebacks, materials, finishes, gemstones, engravings and other details that reflect your vision. For those who want more than one piece, a watch and fine jewelry can share the same symbols, materials or design elements to tell one connected story. From Your Story to the Finished Piece The Conversation We begin by learning about your story, the occasion and what you want the creation to represent. The Design Eddie develops an original concept based on your ideas and direction. The Sketch Your concept begins as a hand drawn design that serves as the foundation for the commission. The Details Materials, gemstones, finishes and personal details are considered to bring the design together. The Creation Once the design is approved, the piece moves into production with selected artisans and specialists. The Reveal Your finished creation is presented with its original design documentation and Atelier presentation materials. Created for One. Made to Become an Heirloom. A Verdure Atelier creation can mark a marriage, celebrate years of hard work, honor a family member or preserve a moment you never want to forget. It is something you can wear today and one day pass to someone who will understand its meaning. The value lies not only in the materials or the craftsmanship, but also in the story that belongs to it. Begin Your Atelier Commission Tell us what you have in mind and the story behind it. Whether you are considering a bespoke timepiece, fine jewelry or a coordinated collection, your first step is a private inquiry. We will guide you through the consultation and explain the next steps for your commission. Verdure Atelier Your story. Your design. Your heirloom. Begin Your Atelier Commission

watches.name: Journeyman Duffle
watches.description: The Journeyman Duffle is built to accompany you through every adventure. Its genuine cowhide exterior develops character with age, while reinforced stitching and premium hardware withstand the demands of frequent travel. Multiple interior pockets and dividers keep your gear organized—from toiletries to electronics—so everything stays exactly where you need it. A structured design maintains its shape whether packed light or full, and comfortable carry handles make transitions between car, plane, and hotel seamless. This is a bag that grows more distinguished with every journey. Made to order—allow 3–5 weeks for production. Custom colors available upon request.

watches.name: Verdure Essential BackPack
watches.description: Crafted from genuine cow hide, this versatile backpack combines durability with timeless style. The rich green leather develops a natural patina over time, adding character to your travels. Snap buttons secure both side pockets and the spacious upper compartment, keeping your essentials organized and protected. A drawstring closure provides an extra layer of security for your most valuable items. Whether you're commuting across the city or embarking on weekend adventures, this backpack offers reliable storage and understated elegance. The premium leather construction ensures it will age beautifully and serve you for years to come. Each Verdure Essential BackPack is made to order, crafted specifically for you to ensure the highest quality and attention to detail. Please allow 3–5 weeks for production and delivery. Message us for custom color options.

watches.name: The Journeyman GMT Automatic GMT Watch | Verdure
watches.description: THE JOURNEYMAN GMT YOUR JOURNEY. YOUR TIME. YOUR STORY. Every journey leaves something behind. The places you've been. The challenges you've overcome. The risks you've taken. The moments that changed you. The milestones you've earned. And the destinations still waiting ahead. The Journeyman GMT was created for that journey. Not simply to mark the hours, but to serve as a reminder of how far you've come and where you're still going. Whether your journey has taken you across continents, through seasons of uncertainty, into new opportunities, or toward accomplishments you once only imagined, every chapter becomes part of your story. The watch is simply there to accompany you. THE JOURNEY Some destinations are measured in miles. Others are measured in moments. The first step. The difficult decision. The unexpected opportunity. The accomplishment you worked years to achieve. Those moments become part of who you are. The Journeyman GMT was inspired by the idea that the journey deserves to be remembered just as much as the destination. Its GMT function reflects the world beyond you, allowing you to keep track of another time zone while carrying a reminder of your own journey wherever you go. Wear it while traveling. Wear it while building. Wear it while celebrating. Wear it while moving toward whatever comes next. Your journey is still being written. THE WATCH The Journeyman GMT brings Verdure's design philosophy to life through a distinctive combination of mechanical movement, world-inspired details, and aviation influences. At the center of the dial is a world map, representing the places we've been and the possibilities that exist beyond where we are today. Airplane-window-inspired hour markers reinforce the spirit of exploration, while the red GMT hand allows you to track an additional time zone. The Verdure “V” appears on the seconds hand as a subtle signature of the brand. Every element has a purpose. Every detail contributes to the story. THE DESIGN The Journeyman GMT was designed to feel different from the expected. Its design begins with an idea rather than simply following what already exists. Founder & Designer Eddie Johnson draws inspiration from art, nature, scripture, and the world around him. An observation can become a sketch, and a sketch can become a complete timepiece concept. That creative process is part of what gives Verdure watches their distinctive character. The Journeyman GMT isn't designed simply to tell time. It's designed to give you something to look at, something to talk about, and something that can eventually become part of your own story. THE DETAILS Every detail of the Journeyman GMT contributes to its identity. WORLD MAP DIAL A visual representation of exploration, movement, and the world beyond. GMT HAND The distinctive red GMT hand allows you to track an additional time zone. AVIATION-INSPIRED HOUR MARKERS Inspired by the windows of an aircraft, reinforcing the watch's connection to travel and exploration. VERDURE “V” SECONDS HAND A subtle signature that brings the Verdure identity into the movement of the dial. BRUSHED FINISH A refined finish that gives the case a sophisticated presence while complementing the watch's overall design. THE EXPERIENCE At the heart of the Journeyman GMT is the NH34A automatic GMT movement. Mechanical watches have a character that goes beyond simply telling time. The complexity of the movement invites you to appreciate the engineering and artistry working beneath the dial. The Journeyman GMT gives you the functionality to track another time zone while maintaining the distinctive design language that makes it unmistakably Verdure. Whether you're stepping onto a plane, walking into an important meeting, celebrating an accomplishment, or simply enjoying an ordinary day, it is designed to be there with you.
